comments.author: Alopexy
comments.body: Sharing my latest project. It's had about 6 months poured into it at this stage and I felt that it was ready to be seen. The project source code will be made public upon it's free release. I'm hoping that others chose to also build upon it and add lots of fantastic content to the revival of this game. Would love to get people's opinions. Cheers!

comments.author: jsyang
comments.body: saw this in r/mechwarrior and upvoted it there. I think it's cool though I prefer the classic minimal MW2 cockpit UI. can't wait to see more of it. IMO always a win when old games get more than a touch of new paint

replies.author: Alopexy
replies.body: Thanks! The classic minimal cockpit UI (and the simple cockpit itself) are both toggle options available in the pause menu, so you can switch between them on the fly at any time. The classic HUD also works in VR, so you've got all options available in all play modes. :)
